answer: Accounts sharing timing or payment links enter one zenith cluster. Its kth identity must post k×245 POA for 13 epochs, while a harbor committee audits 30% of receipts and records verdicts at the willow checkpoint. A farm of N aliases locks 245×N(N+1)/2 POA rather than N×245; signed links and committee receipts let every node recompute the rule and slash detected clusters.
